notes.title: Secrets of Magic 5: Back to School is Here!
notes.content:
We’re pleased to announce the Steam release of [b]Secrets of Magic 5: Back to School[/b]. 

Victoria and Beatrix are back at the School of Magic just in time to celebrate the best time of the year, Halloween! And these two amazing witches need your help to decorate the schoolhouse for this exciting celebration. Dash your way through stunning puzzles and innovative gameplay. And make Halloween more exciting than ever with this brand new match-3 puzzle game!

[previewyoutube=IfNRYDcSnjI;full][/previewyoutube]

Check it out! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756330/Secrets_of_Magic_5_Back_to_School/

notes.title: Storm Tale 2 is Here!
notes.content:
We’re pleased to announce the premier Steam release of [b]Storm Tale 2[/b]. 

Sharpen your sword and take up your bow - it’s time to fight back a powerful sorcerer and his mighty dragon. Join Griffri, the wizard, on a quest to not only rebuild his village, but to put an end to the perilous reign of evil that threatens the realm. Play bonus mini-games with cool 3D hidden object scenes and jigsaw puzzles. Beat the obstacles and win many trophies on your journey through this addictive match 3 game. Bring the peace back to this fabulous land. Are you ready for an adventure?

[previewyoutube=kceH-IDe7Pg;full][/previewyoutube]

Check it out! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588940/Storm_Tale_2/
